name: Kerala Chicken Curry (Nadan Kozhi Curry)
ingredients: Ground garam masala: 1 1/2 tbsp coriander seeds, 1-inch cinnamon, 4 cloves, 2 green cardamom pods, 1/4 tsp black peppercorn, 1 tsp fennel seeds, 1/4 tsp cumin seeds, 2-4 dried red chilies
Tempering: 1 tbsp coconut oil, 1 dried red chili, 3-4 pearl onions sliced, 1 sprig curry leaves
unmapped: coconut oil (board has vegetable-oil/olive-oil/butter/sesame-oil, not coconut oil)
why: 610 cal / 14g carbs / 34g protein per source - the lowest-carb chicken braise found this pass. Structurally low-carb (chicken + onion + tomato + thin coconut milk + toasted spices; no rice/potato in the dish). South Indian Kerala Nadan Kozhi is distinct from the catalog's coconut curries (kuku paka, golden coconut, coconut-chickpea) via curry-leaf/fennel/pearl-onion tempering. Coconut oil + curry leaves + fennel are off-board flags for the pricer lane. Verified from published nutrition on the page.
